faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NBRC Resident Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the NBRC Resident Medical Officer recruitment is 03 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Resident Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is an MBBS degree recognized by the Medical Council of India, along with a valid MCI Registration and at least 6 months of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Resident Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is consolidated, ranging from Rs. 50000 to Rs. 70000, depending on the candidate's experience. Accommodation on campus will also be provided.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the NBRC Resident Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their resume and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Resident Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Resident Medical Officer post announced in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. Can recently retired individuals apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, recently retired individuals (within the last 2 years) or those retiring within the next 3 months are also eligible to apply.
